title: Interpersonal problems as predictors of anxiety symptom trajectories in PTSD: A retrospective multilevel modeling study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: This retrospective quality-control study examined whether patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) at a specialized Norwegian inpatient hospital exhibited high levels of interpersonal problems before treatment and whether these problems predicted anxiety symptom trajectories during treatment.
METHODS: The study analyzed routinely collected data from 58 inpatients with chronic PTSD (M = 44.2 years, SD = 11.0; 51.7% female) who received either Prolonged Exposure (PE) or Metacognitive Therapy (MCT) between 2016 and 2021. Multilevel modeling (MLM) was used to assess weekly self-reported anxiety symptoms measured with the Beck Anxiety Inventory (BAI). Interpersonal problems were measured at pre-treatment using the Inventory of Interpersonal Problems-64-Circumplex (IIP-64-C).
RESULTS: Patients exhibited significantly higher levels of interpersonal problems compared to a Norwegian non-clinical sample but did not differ significantly from a comparable clinical sample. Inconsistent with our hypothesis, higher pre-treatment interpersonal problems did not predict less improvement in anxiety symptoms during inpatient treatment. Furthermore, none of the eight IIP-64-C subscales were significantly associated with anxiety symptom change over time.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that while PTSD inpatients experience elevated interpersonal difficulties, these challenges may not directly hinder anxiety symptom improvement in treatment. The non-significant findings should be interpreted with caution, given the potentially underpowered sample (N = 58), which may have limited the study's ability to detect existing effects. Future research should explore time-varying covariates to better understand fluctuations in interpersonal problems and their impact on PTSD recovery.

title: Reductions in suicide ideation via PTSD symptoms following an anxiety sensitivity intervention: Evidence for chained mediation.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Suicide is a leading cause of death in the United States each year. Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is one disorder that confers risk for suicide, though specific reasons for this are not well understood. Emerging evidence suggests that suicidality and PTSD share a common, malleable vulnerability factor in anxiety sensitivity (AS). This study sought to test these relationships by investigating the pathways through which an AS intervention may reduce suicidal ideation (SI) among a trauma-exposed sample.
METHODS: Clinical outpatients (N = 97) participating in a randomized clinical trial of a computerized AS intervention provided measures of AS at baseline and after the third intervention session; and PTSD and SI symptoms at baseline and follow-ups (1- and 3-months post intervention, respectively).
RESULTS: A chained mediation effect was observed, such that SI at month-three follow-up was lower among the active condition, following condition-specific reductions in AS at session three and PTSD symptoms at one-month follow-up. Reductions in the AS cognitive concerns dimension appeared to be the primary driver of this effect.
CONCLUSIONS: Findings suggest that AS and PTSD symptoms influence SI trajectories and are mechanisms through which SI can be mitigated in at risk samples. Scalable digital interventions that target AS cognitive concerns could be successfully leveraged to remediate both PTSD symptoms and suicide risk.

title: Evaluating the potential of applying artificial intelligence in the diagnosis of major depressive disorder: Neuroimaging and clinical behavioral markers.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Consensus exists that scalable point-of-care capabilities are required to improve the timeliness and accuracy of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) during clinical encounters. Artificial intelligence (AI), through the integration of high-dimensional and multimodal data has emerged with the potential capability to improve the quality and accuracy of MDD diagnosis. While AI diagnostic algorithms are increasingly applied in medical and neurological domains, their role in MDD psychiatric care requires further evaluation.
METHOD: We conducted a targeted narrative commentary of peer-reviewed literature evaluating AI and machine learning applications in MDD diagnosis. Relevant sources were identified through structured PubMed searches and manual reference screening of the neuroimaging, speech and language, digital phenotyping and clinical decision support studies. We further prioritized studies that demonstrated diagnostic classification, replication across cohorts, model interpretability and real-world application.
FINDINGS: Across disparate AI modalities, several algorithms have demonstrated the capacity to identify diagnostic markers that can complement self-report and clinical assessments. Neuroimaging-based classifiers have achieved an accuracy in the diagnosis of MDD that is comparable to expert "ground truth" diagnosis. Notwithstanding, neuroimaging is neither scalable, cost-effective nor affordable. Separately, integrating other aspects of phenomenology and behavior also appears promising as enablers of more timely and accurate diagnoses of MDD.
CONCLUSION: AI-supported diagnostic approaches offer scalable pathways to improve the accuracy and timeliness of MDD detection. Nonetheless, clinically-meaningful implementation requires prospective validation, transparent model reporting to patients and clinicians, as well as mitigation of demographic and algorithmic biases.

title: Classification of suicide attempt history in adolescents with affective disorders: An exploratory machine learning study.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Diagnosis of affective disorders among adolescent population links with the high risk of suicide attempt. The use of clinical psychological scales and biological markers may help to understand the background of suicidal process. Here we present the exploratory data study on retrospective suicide attempt risk factors and classification model of diagnosis conversion from major depressive disorder to bipolar disorder among adolescent population.
METHODS: This retrospective classification study was conducted on 45 adolescent/early-adulthood patients with the diagnosis of major depressive disorders. The psychological profile of patients was assessed with the use of standard clinical scales, like: Defence Style Questionnaire, Barrat Impulsiveness Scale, Beck Depression Inventory, Family APGAR, Emotional Intelligence Questionnaire and Temperament and Character Inventory. We assessed also the baseline concentration of blood-serum proteins: brain-derived neurotrophic factor, proBDNF, epidermal growth factor, macrophage migration inhibitory protein, and Stem Cell Factor. Suicide attempt history was determined at baseline (lifetime occurrence). The machine learning were used to assess the classification of the risk of suicidal attempt as well as diagnosis conversion from major depression to bipolar disorder.
RESULTS: The winning models of machine learning were logistic regression and random forest. Regarding the suicidal attempt risk classification, significant coefficient were found mainly in Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (both factor and item assessment) and Temperament and Character Inventory (AUC = 0.74 (95% CI: 0.53-0.91), permutation p = 0.003). Serum biomarkers showed no discriminative ability (AUC = 0.35-0.40, p > 0.5) for suicide attempts in the past. We found not reliable clinical and biological data on the diagnosis conversion prediction.
CONCLUSION: Clinical psychological scales, not peripheral biomarkers, distinguished suicide attempters in this exploratory analysis.

标题：情感障碍青少年自杀未遂史分类：一项探索性机器学习研究
摘要：引言：青少年情感障碍的诊断与自杀未遂高风险相关。临床心理量表和生物标志物的使用可能有助于理解自杀过程的背景。本文针对青少年人群从重度抑郁症到双相情感障碍的诊断转变，进行了关于回顾性自杀未遂风险因素及分类模型的探索性数据研究。
方法：本回顾性分类研究纳入45名青少年/早期成年人患者，均被诊断为重度抑郁症。使用标准临床量表评估患者的心理特征，包括防御方式问卷、巴瑞特冲动性量表、贝克抑郁量表、家庭适应-伙伴-成长-情感-解决指数、情绪智力量表以及气质与性格量表。我们还检测了基线血清蛋白浓度：脑源性神经营养因子、前脑源性神经营养因子、表皮生长因子、巨噬细胞迁移抑制蛋白和干细胞因子。自杀未遂史在基线时确定（终身发生）。使用机器学习评估自杀未遂风险分类以及从重度抑郁到双相情感障碍的诊断转变。
结果：表现最佳的机器学习模型为逻辑回归和随机森林。关于自杀未遂风险分类，显著系数主要出现在汉密尔顿抑郁评定量表（包括因子和项目评估）以及气质与性格量表（AUC=0.74，95% CI:0.53-0.91，置换检验p=0.003）。血清生物标志物对过去自杀未遂没有判别能力（AUC=0.35-0.40，p>0.5）。在诊断转变预测方面，我们未发现可靠的临床和生物学数据。
结论：在这项探索性分析中，临床心理量表而非外周生物标志物能够区分自杀未遂者。
关键词：情感障碍；自杀未遂；机器学习；临床心理量表；青少年

title: Latent profiles of mood: Toward an empirical definition of mixed mood in youth.
summary: Mixed mood states are a common presentation of pediatric mood disorders. However, their representation in categorical and dimensional taxonomies are misaligned with empirical findings, delaying treatment, and worsening outcomes for youth with mood disorders. To mitigate these negative outcomes, taxonomic representation of mixed mood states (e.g., concomitant symptoms and placement within taxonomic structure) must be reassessed. Therefore, the present study aimed to build empirical definitions of mood disorder dimensions and categorical episode presentations, including mixed mood states, using clinically relevant and substantiated assessments of depression and mania. All participants were families with children, ages 5-18, seeking outpatient mental health services between July 2003 to July 2007. An exploratory factor analysis found that a three-factor solution with manic, depressive, and psychomotor retardation factors best represented the data. A latent profile analyses differentiated seven profiles differentiable as (a) Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder and Disruptive Behavior Disorders, (b) Moderate Low Mood, (c) Major Depressive Episode, (d) Mixed Mood State, (e) Psychomotor Retardation Without Mood Symptoms, (f) Euthymia, (g) Adjustment Disorder and Other Mild Problems. Analyses indicate that depression, mania, and psychomotor retardation may be underlying mood dimensions that distinguish unique groups of youth. Findings also demonstrated that mixed-mood youth can be clearly identified using a dimensional approach despite categorical systems deprioritizing mixed presentation. This study contributes empirical findings that can be used to rebuild categorical or dimensional taxonomies of pediatric mood disorders, which would lead to improved, timely diagnosis and treatment for affected youth.

标题：心境的潜在剖面：青少年混合心境的经验定义探索
摘要：混合心境状态是儿科心境障碍的常见表现。然而，它们在分类学和维度学分类中的表征与实证研究结果不一致，导致治疗延迟，并加重了患有心境障碍的青少年群体的不良预后。为减轻这些负面结果，必须重新评估混合心境状态（例如，共病症状及其在分类结构中的位置）的分类学表征。因此，本研究旨在利用对抑郁和躁狂的临床相关且经验证实的评估，建立心境障碍维度与分类性发作表现（包括混合心境状态）的经验定义。所有参与者均为2003年7月至2007年7月期间寻求门诊心理健康服务的5-18岁儿童及其家庭。探索性因子分析发现，包含躁狂、抑郁和精神运动迟滞的三因子解决方案最能代表数据。潜在剖面分析区分出七个可辨别的剖面：(a) 注意缺陷/多动障碍与破坏性行为障碍，(b) 中度低落心境，(c) 重性抑郁发作，(d) 混合心境状态，(e) 无心境症状的精神运动迟滞，(f) 情绪正常，(g) 适应障碍及其他轻微问题。分析表明，抑郁、躁狂和精神运动迟滞可能是区分青少年不同独特群体的潜在心境维度。研究结果还表明，尽管分类系统降低了混合表现的优先级，但使用维度方法可以明确识别混合心境青少年。本研究提供了可用于重建儿科心境障碍分类或维度分类学的实证发现，这将有助于改善受影响青少年的及时诊断与治疗。
关键词：混合心境状态；潜在剖面分析；心境障碍维度；儿科心境障碍；抑郁与躁狂评估

title: Electroacupuncture ameliorates insomnia with anxiety and depression via modulating slow-wave oscillation, neurotransmitter pathways, and complement system: Insights from EEG and proteomics.
summary:
BACKGROUND: While acupuncture is an established intervention for insomnia, the neurobiological mechanisms linking its modulation of brain activity to molecular-level changes remain poorly understood. This study addresses a critical gap by integrating multimodal data to uncover how electroacupuncture regulates oscillatory activity in specific brain regions and correlates these changes with proteomic alterations.
METHODS: This study employed a multimodal approach combining clinical scales, polysomnography with 26-channel brainwaves, and proteomic analysis to evaluate the effects of acupuncture.
RESULTS: Electroacupuncture significantly improved subjective sleep quality and alleviated anxiety and depression symptoms (p < 0.001). Objectively, it enhanced slow-wave activity (delta, theta, and alpha bands) in key regions such as the frontal and temporal lobes during NREM sleep, while suppressing high-frequency oscillations (beta and gamma bands). Proteomic analysis identified 90 differentially expressed proteins specifically associated with electroacupuncture treatment, including RRM2, ATP5F1E, IRS4, FN1, F5, IDE, UQCRQ, ATP6V0D1, and PPIF. These proteins were enriched in pathways critical to neurotransmitter metabolism (e.g., GABAergic and serotonergic synapses) and complement/coagulation cascades. Correlation analysis revealed significant associations between slow-wave EEG activity and proteins such as UQCRQ and ATP6V0D1 across multiple brain regions (p < 0.05).
CONCLUSION: Electroacupuncture may alleviate insomnia with anxiety and depression by modulating slow-wave synchronization and high-frequency oscillations. This neurophysiological regulation might be mediated through key proteins in signaling pathways linking neural, immune, and metabolic functions. Our study thus provides evidence for a multilevel mechanism supporting electroacupuncture as a multimodal therapy.

标题：电针通过调节慢波振荡、神经递质通路和补体系统改善伴有焦虑和抑郁的失眠：来自脑电图和蛋白质组学的证据
摘要：背景：尽管针灸是失眠的成熟干预手段，但其调节脑活动与分子水平变化之间的神经生物学机制仍不清楚。本研究通过整合多模态数据填补了这一关键空白，揭示电针如何调控特定脑区的振荡活动，并将这些变化与蛋白质组学改变相关联。
方法：本研究采用多模态方法，结合临床量表、多导睡眠图（26通道脑电波）和蛋白质组学分析，评估针灸的效果。
结果：电针显著改善了主观睡眠质量，并缓解了焦虑和抑郁症状（p<0.001）。客观数据显示，电针在非快速眼动睡眠期间增强了额叶和颞叶等关键脑区的慢波活动（δ、θ和α波段），同时抑制了高频振荡（β和γ波段）。蛋白质组学分析鉴定出90种与电针治疗特异相关的差异表达蛋白，包括RRM2、ATP5F1E、IRS4、FN1、F5、IDE、UQCRQ、ATP6V0D1和PPIF。这些蛋白富集于神经递质代谢（如GABA能和5-羟色胺能突触）及补体/凝血级联反应的关键通路中。相关性分析显示，多个脑区的慢波脑电活动与UQCRQ和ATP6V0D1等蛋白之间存在显著关联（p<0.05）。
结论：电针可能通过调节慢波同步和高频振荡来改善伴有焦虑和抑郁的失眠。这种神经生理调节可能由连接神经、免疫和代谢功能的关键信号通路蛋白介导。因此，本研究为电针作为一种多模式疗法的多层次机制提供了证据。
关键词：电针；失眠；焦虑；抑郁；慢波振荡；神经递质通路；补体系统

title: Association between antenatal depression and maternal cortisol diurnal rhythm: A meta-analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Antenatal depression is prevalent and increases risks of adverse maternal and offspring outcomes. Dysregulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, reflected in diurnal cortisol rhythm, is a proposed mechanism, but evidence remains inconsistent.
METHODS: This meta-analysis quantified associations between antenatal depression and cortisol rhythmicity, including the cortisol awakening response (CAR), diurnal slope, and total output (AUCg). Observational studies were identified through systematic searches of five databases up to August 2025. Correlation coefficients were pooled using random-effects models.
RESULTS: Twelve studies were included. Significant negative associations were found between antenatal depression and both CAR (r = -0.33, 95% CI: -0.47 to -0.17, p < 0.001; k = 8, N = 584) and diurnal slope (r = -0.31, 95% CI: -0.52 to -0.07, p = 0.01; k = 7, N = 700), indicating a blunted CAR and a flattened slope. No significant association was found with AUCg (r = 0.04, p = 0.57; k = 7, N = 442). Subgroup analysis indicated that multi-day cortisol sampling attenuated the CAR effect size. Significant heterogeneity was observed for all outcomes.
LIMITATIONS: Potential publication bias and residual heterogeneity suggest caution in interpretation.
CONCLUSION: Antenatal depression is associated with a specific "dynamic dysregulation" of the HPA axis, featuring impaired cortisol dynamics without altered total output. This phenotype may underlie adverse outcomes and inform biological strategies for identification and intervention.

标题：产前抑郁与母亲皮质醇昼夜节律的关联：一项荟萃分析
摘要：背景：产前抑郁普遍存在，并增加母体和后代不良结局的风险。下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴的功能失调（反映在皮质醇昼夜节律上）被认为是其潜在机制，但证据尚不一致。
方法：本荟萃分析量化了产前抑郁与皮质醇节律性（包括皮质醇觉醒反应、昼夜斜率及总分泌量）之间的关联。通过系统检索五大数据库至2025年8月，纳入观察性研究，并采用随机效应模型合并相关系数。
结果：共纳入12项研究。产前抑郁与皮质醇觉醒反应（r = -0.33, 95% CI: -0.47至-0.17, p < 0.001; k = 8, N = 584）及昼夜斜率（r = -0.31, 95% CI: -0.52至-0.07, p = 0.01; k = 7, N = 700）均呈显著负相关，提示觉醒反应减弱且斜率扁平化。总分泌量未见显著关联（r = 0.04, p = 0.57; k = 7, N = 442）。亚组分析表明，多日皮质醇采样可减弱皮质醇觉醒反应效应量。所有结局均存在显著异质性。
局限：潜在的发表偏倚和残余异质性提示需谨慎解读结果。
结论：产前抑郁与下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴的特异性“动态失调”相关，表现为皮质醇动态受损而无总分泌量改变。该表型可能介导不良结局，并为识别与干预的生物学策略提供依据。
关键词：产前抑郁；皮质醇昼夜节律；HPA轴功能失调；情绪障碍；荟萃分析

title: Self-esteem, inflammatory cytokines, and cognitive function in adolescents with emotional dysregulation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Accumulating evidence links emotion dysregulation (ED) to systemic inflammation and impaired cognitive function. However, whether low self-esteem (LSE) may relate to systemic inflammation and cognitive dysfunction remains uncertain, despite its frequent co-occurrence with emotion dysregulation.
METHODS: In total, 105 adolescents with emotion dysregulation (ED), including 51 with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, 26 with bipolar disorder, and 28 with major depressive disorder, and 54 neurotypical adolescents were enrolled. LSE was operationalized as a Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES) total score < 15. All participants completed assessments of mood and attention symptoms and assays of proinflammatory markers, including C-reactive protein (CRP); interleukins (IL)-2, -6, and -17; interferon-γ; and tumor necrosis factor-α. The go/no-go task and 2-back working memory test were also performed.
RESULTS: In generalized linear models adjusting for demographics, clinical symptom severity, and medication use, LSE was independently associated with higher CRP levels (Wald χ2 = 4.256, p = 0.039), whereas ED was independently associated with elevated IL-17 levels (Wald χ2 = 14.093, p < 0.001). In addition, we also found an association between ED and impaired working memory function.
DISCUSSION: LSE may reflect low-grade systemic inflammation, independent of mood and attention symptoms. ED showed selective links to elevated IL-17 and worse working memory. Longitudinal work is required to determine temporal precedence and disentangle causal mechanisms among these domains.

标题：情绪失调青少年的自尊、炎症因子与认知功能
摘要：背景：越来越多的证据将情绪失调与系统性炎症及认知功能受损联系起来。然而，低自尊是否可能与系统性炎症和认知功能障碍相关仍不确定，尽管它常与情绪失调并存。方法：共纳入105名情绪失调青少年（其中51名患有注意缺陷多动障碍，26名患有双相障碍，28名患有重度抑郁症）和54名神经典型青少年。低自尊操作定义为罗森堡自尊量表总分<15。所有参与者完成了情绪和注意症状评估，以及促炎标志物检测，包括C反应蛋白、白细胞介素-2、白细胞介素-6、白细胞介素-17、干扰素-γ和肿瘤坏死因子-α。此外，还执行了Go/No-go任务和2-back工作记忆测试。结果：在调整人口统计学、临床症状严重程度和用药情况的广义线性模型中，低自尊与更高的C反应蛋白水平独立相关（Wald χ²=4.256, p=0.039），而情绪失调与白细胞介素-17升高独立相关（Wald χ²=14.093, p<0.001）。此外，我们还发现情绪失调与工作记忆功能受损之间存在关联。结论：低自尊可能反映低度系统性炎症，且独立于情绪和注意症状。情绪失调则与白细胞介素-17升高及更差的工作记忆具有选择性关联。未来需进行纵向研究以确定时间优先顺序并厘清这些领域之间的因果机制。
关键词：情绪失调；自尊；炎症因子；认知功能；青少年

title: Shift to the core: Abnormal core-periphery global topography in unipolar and bipolar depression.
summary: This study explores the global signal topography of core and periphery brain networks in Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), Bipolar disorder (BD-Dep) and healthy controls (HC) using resting-state fMRI. In a sample of 140 depressed MDD and BD patients, and 70 HC, we observed a significant shift toward increased activity in the transmodal-core regions (e.g., default mode network, frontoparietal network) at the expense of unimodal-periphery regions (e.g., visual, sensory-motor cortices) in both depressed MDD and BD patients compared to HC. Whole brain machine learning analyses further demonstrated that altered global signal dynamics can effectively distinguish MDD and BD from HC (ACC = 79% and 77% respectively). Notably, we identified a significant negative correlation between global signal correlation in unimodal-periphery networks and depressive symptom severity. Additionally, in a smaller sample of BD during mania (N = 22) a distinct topographic pattern was observed, with increased global representation in the unimodal-periphery compared to depressive states, suggesting mood state-dependent shifts in network organization. To assess multivariate discriminability across diagnostic groups, a Partial Least Squares (PLS) analysis revealed that higher Core and related network activity (DMN, FPN) predicted diagnostic assignment to MDD and BD-Dep, whereas higher Periphery and related network (e.g., visual and sensory-motor networks) predicted assignment to BD-Man and HC. The Core-Periphery (C-P) ratio emerged as the strongest predictor (VIP = 1.65). These results underscore the critical role of global signal topography in mood disorders, particularly the imbalance between core and peripheral brain networks, as a potential neurobiological marker for depressive states.

标题：转向核心：单相抑郁与双相抑郁中核心-边缘全局拓扑结构的异常
摘要：本研究利用静息态功能磁共振成像探究了重性抑郁障碍、双相障碍（抑郁期）及健康对照中核心与边缘脑网络的全局信号拓扑结构。在140名抑郁状态的重性抑郁障碍及双相障碍患者以及70名健康对照的样本中，我们观察到与健康对照相比，抑郁状态的重性抑郁障碍和双相障碍患者均呈现出跨模态核心区域（如默认模式网络、额顶网络）的活动显著增强，而单模态边缘区域（如视觉、感觉运动皮层）的活动相应减弱的显著转变。全脑机器学习分析进一步表明，改变的全局信号动力学能够有效区分重性抑郁障碍和双相障碍与健康对照（准确率分别为79%和77%）。值得注意的是，我们发现在单模态边缘网络中的全局信号相关性与抑郁症状严重程度呈显著负相关。此外，在一个较小样本的双相障碍躁狂期患者（N=22）中，观察到与抑郁状态相比不同的拓扑模式，即单模态边缘区域的全局表征增强，提示网络组织存在情绪状态依赖性转变。为评估诊断组间的多变量可区分性，偏最小二乘分析揭示，较高的核心及相关网络（默认模式网络、额顶网络）活动预测重性抑郁障碍和双相障碍抑郁期的诊断归属，而较高的边缘及相关网络（如视觉和感觉运动网络）活动则预测双相障碍躁狂期和健康对照的归属。核心-边缘比率成为最强的预测因子（VIP=1.65）。这些结果强调了全局信号拓扑结构在情绪障碍中的关键作用，特别是核心与边缘脑网络之间的失衡，作为抑郁状态潜在神经生物学标志物。
关键词：单相抑郁；双相抑郁；核心-边缘拓扑结构；全局信号；静息态功能磁共振成像

title: Electrocortical correlates of facial expression processing: Assessing associations with stress, loneliness and exploring sex and hormone interactions.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Little is known about how stress and loneliness affect behavioural and neural correlates of face emotion recognition, particularly when assessed using event-related potentials (ERPs). Moreover, the influence of sex/menstrual cycle phase and sex hormones on these relations has not been explored, representing a notable literature gap.
METHODS: Participants (N = 78, 50F) completed a face emotion recognition task while undergoing electroencephalographic (EEG) recordings. The Perceived Stress Scale (PSS) and UCLA Loneliness Scales (ULS) were completed, and salivary cortisol, estradiol, progesterone and testosterone were collected. Face-sensitive (N170, VPP, EPN), sensory-processing (P2, N1), and cognitive-control/evaluation-related ERPs (N2 LPP) were assessed reflecting the various stages of facial expression processing.
RESULTS: Higher loneliness was linked with increased cortisol levels. Higher P2 amplitudes and greater late LPPs existed in those with low stress; those with low stress also had smaller VPP amplitudes, particularly to fear and disgust faces. Low loneliness was associated with longer N1 latencies to disgust. Perceived stress and loneliness influenced performance depending on menstrual cycle phases in females. Males vs. females with higher stress showed larger N170 amplitudes to fear and disgust; females in the follicular vs. luteal phase with higher loneliness had enhanced LPPs to negative emotions.
CONCLUSIONS: Complex interactions between loneliness, stress and sex-related factors in emotion recognition exist. Particularly, there appears to be increased sensitivity to negative facial expressions shaped by stress, loneliness and menstrual cycle phase. These insights advance integrative models of emotion processing by considering psychosocial and sex-related factors within a more holistic approach beyond isolated factors.

标题：面部表情加工的皮层电生理关联：评估与压力、孤独感的关联，并探索性别与激素交互作用

摘要：背景：关于压力和孤独感如何影响面部情绪识别的行为及神经关联，尤其是在事件相关电位（ERP）评估下，我们知之甚少。此外，性别/月经周期阶段及性激素对这些关系的影响尚未被探索，这构成了文献中的一个显著空白。方法：参与者（N=78，其中50名女性）在执行面部情绪识别任务的同时接受脑电图（EEG）记录。完成了感知压力量表（PSS）和UCLA孤独感量表（ULS），并收集了唾液皮质醇、雌二醇、孕酮和睾酮水平。评估了面部敏感性（N170、VPP、EPN）、感觉加工（P2、N1）以及认知控制/评价相关（N2、LPP）的ERP成分，以反映面部表情加工的不同阶段。结果：较高的孤独感与皮质醇水平升高相关。低压力者表现出较高的P2波幅和较大的晚期LPP；低压力者还表现出较小的VPP波幅，尤其对恐惧和厌恶面孔。低孤独感与对厌恶面孔的N1潜伏期延长相关。感知压力和孤独感对女性任务表现的影响取决于月经周期阶段。与女性相比，压力较高的男性对恐惧和厌恶面孔表现出更大的N170波幅；在卵泡期（相对于黄体期）且孤独感较高的女性中，对负性情绪的LPP增强。结论：情绪识别中存在孤独感、压力与性别相关因素之间的复杂交互作用。特别是，由压力、孤独感和月经周期阶段塑造的对面部负性情绪的敏感性增强。这些发现通过在一个更整体的视角中综合考虑社会心理和性别相关因素（而非孤立因素），推进了情绪加工的整合模型。

title: A meta-analysis of the late positive potential for assessing affective processing in depression and depression vulnerability.
summary: Depression and conditions conferring vulnerability to depression are thought to involve disruptions in emotional processing, yet the specific patterns and underlying neural mechanisms of these alterations remain unclear. To investigate emotional processing, studies often rely on tasks involving the viewing of standardized emotional visual stimuli, which elicit a range of psychophysiological responses. In this context, the late positive potential (LPP), an event-related potential reflecting motivated attention and emotional engagement, has emerged as a promising biomarker of emotional processing and has been applied in the study of depression. This preregistered meta-analysis quantitatively synthesized 23 studies (N = 2190) comparing LPP amplitudes to emotional visual stimuli in individuals with depressive symptoms, remitted depression, or familial risk, relative to controls. Across all stimulus categories, the whole sample of individuals with depressive symptoms and at-risk groups exhibited significantly reduced LPP, indicating a potential attenuated engagement with visual stimuli. Moderator analyses indicated that this pattern was not uniform across populations. In adults, reduced LPP amplitudes were evident for emotional but not neutral stimuli, whereas findings in developmental samples were heterogeneous and underpowered. Importantly, effects in at-risk populations were inconsistent and based on a limited number of studies, warranting cautious interpretation. Within-group analyses (11 studies; N = 1154) confirmed preserved affective modulation across samples, with larger LPPs to pleasant and unpleasant versus neutral stimuli. Overall, findings partly support the emotion context insensitivity hypothesis, suggesting a generalized attenuation of emotional processing in adults with depression or at-risk.

标题：评估抑郁症及抑郁易感性情绪加工中的晚期正电位：一项元分析  
摘要：抑郁症及易患抑郁的条件被认为涉及情绪加工的中断，但这些改变的具体模式及其潜在神经机制仍不清楚。为研究情绪加工，研究常依赖于观看标准化情绪视觉刺激的任务，这类刺激会引发一系列心理生理反应。在此背景下，晚期正电位（LPP）作为一种反映动机性注意和情绪参与的事件相关电位，已成为情绪加工的有前景的生物标志物，并应用于抑郁症研究。这项预先注册的元分析对23项研究（N=2190）进行了定量综合，比较了有抑郁症状、抑郁缓解或家族风险的个体与对照组在面对情绪视觉刺激时的LPP振幅。在所有刺激类别中，抑郁症状个体及高风险组的整体样本表现出显著减弱的LPP，表明对视觉刺激的参与可能存在削弱。调节变量分析显示，这种模式在不同人群中并非一致。在成人中，减弱的LPP振幅仅对情绪刺激（而非中性刺激）显著，而发展样本中的结果则异质性高且统计效力不足。重要的是，高风险人群中的效应不一致且基于有限研究，需谨慎解释。组内分析（11项研究；N=1154）证实了各样本中情感调节的保持，即对愉快和不愉快刺激的LPP大于对中性刺激。总体而言，研究结果部分支持情绪语境不敏感假说，表明抑郁症或高风险成人中存在情绪加工的整体减弱。  
关键词：晚期正电位；情绪加工；抑郁症；抑郁易感性；元分析

title: Trans-developmental stability of self-criticism as a core target in adolescent anxiety-depression comorbidity: Insights from stage-specific network analysis and in silico interventions.
summary: Adolescent anxiety-depression comorbidity constitutes a pressing public health challenge. While personality vulnerability (PV)-comprising dependency and self-criticism-is a key transdiagnostic mechanism, its developmental stability versus stage-specificity of these dimensions as an intervention target remains unresolved. This study leveraged stage-specific network analysis and in silico interventions across early (11-13), middle (14-16), and late (17-19) adolescence (N = 73,669) to identify optimal vulnerable targets for anxiety-depression networks. Bayesian hypothesis testing evaluated evidential support for network edges. Results identified SC3 (disappointing others) as a trans-developmentally stable core node and the primary bridge connecting PV to symptoms, with Bayesian analyses strongly supporting the strongest pathway between SC3 and PHQ6 (guilt). Crucially, in silico interventions quantified downstream effects on comorbid symptoms via iterative aggravation and alleviation of each vulnerable node's value. Results revealed distinct functional dynamics. In aggravating simulations, SC3 consistently emerged as the most potent trans-developmental trigger. Conversely, alleviating simulations revealed a developmental gradient: while dependency nodes demonstrated comparable symptom reduction to SC2 (far from how I would like to be) in early adolescence, SC2 solidified as the statistically dominant maintainer in middle and late adolescence. These findings offer hypothesis-generating insights for a developmentally tailored strategy: prioritizing the desensitization of interpersonal shame (SC3) for trans-developmental prevention, while shifting treatment focus from early relational antecedents to restructuring the overarching, internalized ideal-self discrepancy (SC2) in older adolescents.

标题：青少年焦虑-抑郁共病中自我批评作为核心目标的跨发展阶段稳定性：来自阶段特异性网络分析与计算机模拟干预的见解
摘要：青少年焦虑-抑郁共病构成了一个紧迫的公共卫生挑战。虽然人格脆弱性（包括依赖和自我批评）是一个关键的跨诊断机制，但作为干预目标的这些维度的跨发展阶段稳定性与阶段性特异性仍不明确。本研究利用阶段特异性网络分析和计算机模拟干预，跨越青少年早期（11-13岁）、中期（14-16岁）和晚期（17-19岁）三个阶段（N=73,669），识别焦虑-抑郁网络中的最佳易感目标。贝叶斯假设检验评估了网络边的证据支持。结果显示，SC3（让他人失望）是一个跨发展阶段稳定的核心节点，也是连接人格脆弱性与症状的主要桥梁，贝叶斯分析强烈支持SC3与PHQ6（内疚感）之间的最强路径。关键在于，计算机模拟干预通过迭代加重和减轻每个易感节点的数值，量化了对共病症状的下游效应。结果揭示了不同的功能动态：在加重模拟中，SC3始终是最强的跨发展阶段触发因素；而在缓解模拟中，发现了发展梯度：在青少年早期，依赖节点与SC2（远离理想中自我）表现出相当的减轻症状效果，但在青少年中期和晚期，SC2确立了作为统计上主导的维持因素的地位。这些发现为发展性定制策略提供了生成假设的见解：优先通过去敏感化人际羞耻感（SC3）进行跨发展阶段预防，而将治疗重点从早期青少年的关系前因转向重构晚期青少年中更具概括性的、内化的理想自我差距（SC2）。
关键词：自我批评；焦虑-抑郁共病；青少年；网络分析；计算机模拟干预

title: Unstable sleep and rest-activity rhythms in adolescents at-risk for bipolar disorder: Links to mood symptoms and the effect of sleep stabilization.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Adolescents with a parental history of bipolar disorder (BD; High-Risk) are more likely to develop BD than those without such history (Low-Risk). Actigraphy studies in adults indicate that instability in sleep and rest-activity rhythms (RAR) may be associated with progression to BD. However, it remains unclear whether High- and Low-Risk adolescents are differentially affected by sleep and RAR instability and their impact on emerging mood symptoms.
METHODS: We recruited 50 adolescents unaffected by BD (mean age[SD] = 15.97[1.31], 58% female) stratified into High-Risk (N = 22) and Low-Risk (N = 28) groups. All participants completed two weeks of Baseline actigraphy; a subset of 11 High-Risk participants then completed a two-week sleep stabilization Manipulation at home targeting regular sleep timing and duration. Depression and mania rating scales were collected at Baseline and post-Manipulation. We examined between-group differences in sleep duration variability, midsleep variability, and Circadian Function Index (CFI; measure of circadian activity robustness), tested group moderation of associations with mood symptoms, and examined effects of the sleep stabilization protocol.
RESULTS: We found no between-group-differences (P-values>0.05). Among High-Risk participants only, greater sleep duration variability was linked to higher levels of depressive (β[95%CI] = 0.012[0.006,0.018]) and mania (β[95%CI] = 0.011[0.003,0.019]) symptoms, and lower CFI was linked to greater mania symptoms (β[95%CI] = -8.236[-12.525,-3.940]). The sleep stabilization protocol reduced sleep duration (P < 0.001) and midsleep (P = 0.005) variability and improved CFI (P = 0.044), with trend-level reductions in subthreshold mania symptoms.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight that sleep and RAR instability may have a stronger impact on mood in High-Risk adolescents but simple behavioral interventions stabilizing sleep and rhythms could buffer against BD risk.

标题：双相障碍风险青少年睡眠与休息-活动节律的不稳定性：与情绪症状的关联及睡眠稳定化的效果
摘要：背景：有双相障碍（BD）父母病史（高风险）的青少年比无此类病史（低风险）的青少年更可能发展为BD。成人体动记录研究显示，睡眠与休息-活动节律（RAR）的不稳定性可能与BD的进展相关。然而，目前尚不清楚高风险与低风险青少年是否在睡眠和RAR不稳定性及其对新兴情绪症状的影响上存在差异。方法：我们招募了50名未受BD影响的青少年（平均年龄[标准差]=15.97[1.31]，58%为女性），分为高风险组（N=22）和低风险组（N=28）。所有参与者完成了两周的基线体动记录；随后，11名高风险参与者在家接受了为期两周的睡眠稳定化干预，重点调节规律的睡眠时间和时长。在基线和干预后收集抑郁和躁狂评定量表。我们检查了组间在睡眠时长变异性、中值睡眠时间变异性和昼夜节律功能指数（CFI；昼夜活动稳健性指标）上的差异，测试了组别对情绪症状关联的调节作用，并评估了睡眠稳定化方案的效果。结果：组间未发现显著差异（P值>0.05）。仅在风险参与者中，更大的睡眠时长变异性与更高水平的抑郁症状（β[95%CI]=0.012[0.006,0.018]）和躁狂症状（β[95%CI]=0.011[0.003,0.019]）相关，较低的CFI与更大的躁狂症状相关（β[95%CI]=-8.236[-12.525,-3.940]）。睡眠稳定化方案减少了睡眠时长（P<0.001）和中值睡眠时间（P=0.005）的变异性，并改善了CFI（P=0.044），同时亚阈值躁狂症状有趋势水平的降低。结论：这些发现强调，睡眠和RAR不稳定性可能对高风险青少年的情绪产生更强的影响，但通过简单行为干预稳定睡眠和节律可能缓冲BD风险。

title: Neurobiological architecture of first-episode, drug-naive late-life depression: Insights from multimodal MRI, transcriptomics, and neurotransmitter mapping.
summary:
PURPOSE: To elucidate the neurobiological architecture of late-life depression (LLD) by integrating macroscopic multimodal MRI with microscopic transcriptomic and neurochemical mapping.
METHODS: We analyzed 39 first-episode, drug-naive LLD patients and 41 matched healthy controls (HC) using structural MRI, diffusion kurtosis imaging, and resting-state fMRI. Data were processed to extract gray matter volume (GMV), white matter diffusion metrics (FA, MD, AD, RD), and functional indices (fALFF, DC), with group differences evaluated under rigorous multiple-comparison corrections. To elucidate molecular underpinnings, partial least squares (PLS) regression was applied to link neuroimaging t-maps with Allen Human Brain Atlas gene expression profiles. Spatial correlations between neuroimaging statistical maps and PET-derived neurotransmitter receptor density maps were further examined to identify neurochemical substrates.
RESULTS: LLD patients exhibited localized gray matter volume (GMV) reductions in the right fusiform gyrus and limbic structures, widespread microstructural white matter degradation across fronto-limbic tracts, and increased functional amplitude and network centrality centered on the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC). Transcriptomic decoding linked these macroscopic anomalies to gene sets enriched for mitochondrial metabolism, calcium signaling, and synaptic organization. Furthermore, spatial correlation analyses uniquely revealed that structural atrophy was predominantly associated with the glutamatergic system, whereas functional and network alterations aligned most robustly with the opioid system.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings support a multi-scale neurobiological model of LLD, wherein distinct molecular deficits in bioenergetics, glutamatergic excitotoxicity, and opioid neurotransmission underlie macroscopic structural and functional network failures. This integrative framework identifies specific neurochemical systems as prime mechanistic substrates and potential therapeutic targets for the cognitive-emotional dysregulation characteristic of LLD.

摘要：目的：通过整合宏观多模态MRI与微观转录组学和神经化学图谱，阐明晚年抑郁症（LLD）的神经生物学架构。方法：我们分析了39名首发未用药LLD患者和41名匹配的健康对照组（HC），使用结构MRI、弥散峰度成像和静息态功能MRI。数据处理提取灰质体积（GMV）、白质弥散指标（FA、MD、AD、RD）和功能指标（fALFF、DC），并在严格多重比较校正下评估组间差异。为阐明分子基础，采用偏最小二乘（PLS）回归将神经影像t图与艾伦人脑图谱基因表达谱关联。进一步检查神经影像统计图与PET衍生的神经递质受体密度图之间的空间相关性，以识别神经化学底物。结果：LLD患者在右侧梭状回和边缘结构表现出局部灰质体积减少，额叶-边缘通路的广泛微结构白质退化，以及以内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）为中心的功能振幅和网络中心性增加。转录组解码将这些宏观异常与富集线粒体代谢、钙信号和突触组织的基因集联系起来。此外，空间相关分析独特地揭示结构萎缩主要与谷氨酸能系统相关，而功能和网络改变则与阿片样系统最吻合。结论：我们的研究结果支持LLD的多尺度神经生物学模型，其中生物能量学、谷氨酸兴奋毒性和阿片能神经传递的不同分子缺陷是宏观结构和功能网络衰竭的基础。该整合框架确定了特定神经化学系统作为LLD特征性认知-情绪失调的主要机制底物和潜在治疗靶点。

title: Accelerometer-derived hourly segmentation of daily physical activity frequency and brain health: A prospective cohort study in middle-aged/older adults.
summary: Physical activity (PA) is known to enhance brain health; however, prior research has predominantly concentrated on the total volume of PA, often overlooking the frequency of daily PA on an hourly basis. This prospective cohort study examined 69,393 middle-aged and older adults, utilizing wrist-worn accelerometer data to assess PA. A novel PA frequency score was developed, which integrated light PA (LPA) and moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA) across 18 hourly segments (6:00 AM-12:00 AM). Participants were categorized into Inactive, Active, and Very Active groups. After adjusting for potential confounders, it was observed that individuals in the Active and Very Active groups exhibited a reduced risk of developing brain disorders such as dementia, anxiety, depression, migraine, Parkinson's disease, and stroke over a median follow-up period of 7.41 years. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) findings demonstrated that each unit increase in the PA frequency score correlated with a 51.55 mm3 reduction in white matter hyperintensities, effectively offsetting approximately two months of typical age-related WMH progression. It is important to note that these findings may be particularly relevant to middle-aged and older adults, as the initial diagnoses of depression or anxiety in this demographic likely represent late-onset sub-phenotypes. These results demonstrate that most associations remained statistically significant independent of the total volume of LPA/MVPA, underscoring the significance of increasing the number of hourly active segments that may contribute to maintaining brain health, thereby providing novel evidence for public health initiatives.

标题：基于加速度计每日体力活动频率的每小时分段与大脑健康：一项针对中老年人的前瞻性队列研究  
摘要：已知体力活动（PA）可促进大脑健康；然而，先前研究主要集中于PA的总体积，常忽略以小时为基础的每日PA频率。这项前瞻性队列研究纳入了69,393名中老年人，利用腕戴式加速度计数据评估PA。我们开发了一种新型PA频率评分，该评分整合了18个每小时时段（上午6:00至午夜12:00）内的轻度PA（LPA）和中高强度PA（MVPA）。参与者被分为不活跃、活跃和非常活跃三组。调整潜在混杂因素后，在7.41年的中位随访期内，活跃组和非常活跃组的个体患痴呆、焦虑、抑郁、偏头痛、帕金森病及中风等大脑疾病的风险较低。磁共振成像（MRI）结果显示，PA频率评分每增加一个单位，白质高信号（WMH）体积减少51.55 mm³，这相当于抵消了约两个月年龄相关的典型WMH进展。需要注意的是，这些发现可能尤其适用于中老年人，因为该人群中抑郁或焦虑的初次诊断可能代表晚发性亚表型。结果表明，大多数关联在独立于LPA/MVPA总体积后仍具有统计学显著性，这强调了增加每小时活跃时段数量对维持大脑健康的重要性，从而为公共卫生举措提供了新证据。

title: Low reward responsiveness as a moderator of chronic stress effects on depressive symptoms in adolescents: An examination of monetary and social rewards.
summary: Exposure to stressors is a known risk factor for depression. Not all who experience stress develop depression, raising questions about vulnerabilities. Low neural reward responsiveness may be a vulnerability for depression in combination with stress. Research has primarily focused on responses to monetary rewards. Additional work is needed examining reward responsiveness across domains to investigate where patterns potentially diverge in understanding vulnerabilities for depression. To address this gap, we compared interactive effects between chronic stress and neural responses to monetary and social reward on depressive symptoms, covarying for sex. Adolescents between 14 and 17 years (N = 165), oversampled for current depression and maternal depression, completed simulated peer interaction and monetary reward tasks while electroencephalography data were recorded to measure the reward positivity (RewP) event-related potential. Chronic stress over the past 6 months was assessed using the UCLA Life Stress Interview. Participants completed a self-report measure of depressive symptoms. In separate models for each measure of reward responsiveness, chronic stress interacted with monetary (p = .020) and social (p = .002) RewP, such that chronic stress was more strongly associated with depressive symptoms for adolescents with relatively blunted reward responsiveness. In a model including both measures of reward responsiveness, the chronic stress interaction with social but not monetary RewP was significant (p = .041). These results support the role of reward responsiveness in shaping responses to stress, and the present study expands the literature by extending monetary reward research to the social domain.

标题：低奖赏反应性作为慢性压力对青少年抑郁症状影响的中介因素：货币与社会奖赏的考察
摘要：暴露于压力源是抑郁症已知的风险因素。并非所有经历压力的人都会发展出抑郁症状，这引发了对易感性的探讨。低神经奖赏反应性可能与压力相结合，成为抑郁症的易感因素。现有研究主要关注对货币奖赏的反应，还需跨领域考察奖赏反应性，以探究在理解抑郁易感性时模式可能存在的差异。为填补这一空白，我们比较了慢性压力与神经对货币和社会奖赏的反应性之间的交互作用对抑郁症状的影响，并将性别作为协变量。研究对象为14至17岁青少年（N=165），其中过度采样了当前有抑郁症及母亲有抑郁症的个体。他们完成了模拟同伴互动和货币奖赏任务，同时记录脑电图数据以测量奖赏正波（RewP）事件相关电位。过去6个月的慢性压力通过UCLA生活压力访谈评估。参与者完成了抑郁症状自我报告问卷。在针对每种奖赏反应性的独立模型中，慢性压力与货币奖赏（p=0.020）及社会奖赏（p=0.002）的RewP存在交互作用：对于奖赏反应性相对迟钝的青少年，慢性压力与抑郁症状的关联更强。在同时包含两种奖赏反应性指标的模型中，慢性压力与社会奖赏RewP的交互作用显著（p=0.041），而与货币奖赏RewP的交互作用不显著。这些结果支持奖赏反应性在塑造压力反应中的作用，本研究通过将货币奖赏研究扩展至社会领域，丰富了现有文献。

title: The mechanism of depression and anxiety in adulthood after experiencing early adverse experiences: A new two-hit model of depression.
summary: Adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) increase susceptibility to depression and anxiety disorders in adulthood. This study investigated the potential mechanisms through which ACEs enhance vulnerability to depression and anxiety in adulthood, using a novel "two-hit" mouse model by combining maternal separation (MS) with 14 or 21 days of restraint stress (RS). Behavioral assessments (sucrose preference test, tail suspension test, open field test, elevated zero maze) confirmed depressive- and anxiety-like behaviors in the MS + RS 21d group mice. Neurobiological analyses revealed hyperactivity of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis (elevated serum corticosterone [CORT] and adrenocorticotropic hormone [ACTH]) and dysregulation, characterized by reduced levels of monoamine neurotransmitters (5-hydroxytryptamine [5-HT], 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid, dopamine, norepinephrine), altered mRNA expression of key genes (e.g., increased ACTH, CRH, SERT; decreased GR, brain-derived neurotrophic factor [BDNF]), and corresponding protein-level changes (e.g., increased 5-HT1AR, CRHRs; decreased BDNF, TrkB). Our findings indicate that the two-hit mouse model, combining MS with a 21-day RS, stably induces depressive- and anxiety-like behaviors in mice. The underlying mechanism may be associated with HPA axis dysfunction, serotonergic system dysregulation, and aberrant BDNF signaling within the prefrontal cortex-amygdala-hypothalamus circuit.

title: Association between maternal depression and parenting practices: A longitudinal study with children from low-income families.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Maternal depressive symptoms (MDS) are common in low-income Brazilian settings, yet longitudinal evidence on their links to parenting is limited. We examined whether MDS measured in infancy and early school age are associated with parenting practices at child school entry (∼5.5 years).
METHODS: We used longitudinal data from the Impact Evaluation of Brazil's Happy Child Program (PCF), implemented in municipalities across four Brazilian macro-regions. The cohort included 3242 families at baseline (T0, 2018) and 1014 mother-child dyads with complete data at the fourth follow-up (T4, 2024). MDS was assessed at T0 and T4 using the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS). Parenting practices were assessed at T4 using the Parenting and Family Adjustment Scales (PAFAS). Associations were estimated using multivariable linear regression with municipality-level cluster-robust standard errors, adjusted for child sex and maternal sociodemographic characteristics. Sensitivity analyses used mixed-effects models (municipality random intercept) with BH-FDR adjustment and continuous EPDS scores.
RESULTS: Maternal depression point prevalence was 26.5% at baseline (T0) and 31.5% at child school entry (T4). Maternal depression at both T0 and T4 was associated with higher (worse) overall PAFAS scores and higher scores for coercive practices, parental consistency, and parent-child relationship at T4. Associations for positive encouragement were smaller, with weaker evidence at T0 and clearer associations at T4. Findings were robust across sensitivity analyses.
CONCLUSIONS: Maternal depressive symptoms in infancy and at child school entry are associated with less favorable parenting practices at early school age in low-income families. Integrating depression care with parenting supports may improve child development in resource-constrained settings.

title: Predictors of responsiveness to ketamine: An updated systematic review of neuroimaging findings.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a leading cause of disability worldwide, with a significant portion of patients experiencing treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Ketamine, a rapid-acting antidepressant, has shown promise in alleviating symptoms of TRD and suicidality, but variability in treatment response remains a challenge. Identifying neuroimaging biomarkers that predict responsiveness to ketamine could enhance treatment precision and efficacy.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic search on PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science databases of neuroimaging studies exploring biomarkers predictive of responsiveness to ketamine in MDD and suicidality.
RESULTS: Fifteen studies were included in this updated review. The anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and the amygdala emerged as significant regions of interest. Notably, connectivity of the pregenual ACC and the amygdala with other brain regions was frequently associated with better response to ketamine. Furthermore, diffusion MRI showed higher fractional anisotropy in cingulum of responders to ketamine. Structural MRI studies, on the other hand, found that hippocampus volume had a significant positive correlation with response to ketamine. Moreover, proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy showed that responders had a higher Glx/glutamate ratio in the dorsomedial/dorsal anterolateral. Finally, also task-based imaging showed that ACC activity was predictive of antidepressant response.
LIMITATIONS: This review presents some limitations, including heterogeneity in psychological assessments, follow-up duration, ketamine dosage, and imaging protocols across the included studies.
CONCLUSION: The review identifies the ACC, amygdala, and their connectivity with other brain regions as potential neuroimaging biomarkers for predicting responsiveness to ketamine in MDD. Future studies should aim to standardize methodologies and explore the role of different ketamine administration routes.

title: Thyroid dysfunction and Research Domain Criteria framework-based depression phenotypes: Insights from a historical longitudinal cohort.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Depression is a clinically heterogeneous disorder, making it difficult to identify its biological underpinnings, including potential links to dysregulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-thyroid axis, which plays a central role in the pathophysiology of depression. The Research Domain Criteria (RDoC) framework provides a multi-dimensional approach to parsing depressive phenotypes. This study investigates the association between thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) abnormalities and depressive symptoms mapped to RDoC domains.
METHODS: In a retrospective cohort from 2000 to 2021, adults with euthymic (PHQ-9 < 5) and euthyroid (TSH >0.3-4.2 mIU/L) baseline status and at least two TSH-PHQ-9 paired assessments within six months were included. PHQ-9 items were mapped to four RDoC-aligned domains: Negative Valence-Externalizing, Negative Valence-Internalizing, Arousal/Regulatory (AR) Systems, and Cognitive/Sensorimotor (CS) Systems. Linear mixed-effects models adjusted for covariates were used to assess the association between subsequent TSH dysfunction (low TSH ≤0.3 mIU/L and high TSH >4.2 mIU/L) and domain scores.
RESULTS: Among 6191 adults (mean age, 50.2 years; 67% female; 92.4% White), abnormal TSH levels are associated with higher AR Systems scores, with higher mean AR scores for low TSH (2.54; 95% CI, 2.38-2.70) and high TSH (2.57; 95% CI, 2.44-2.69) compared with normal TSH (2.40; 95% CI, 2.29-2.50; p ≤ .04). No significant differences were found in other RDoC domains.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings support the utility of a biologically informed, dimensional framework in depression research. Elevated AR Systems symptoms in the context of abnormal TSH levels may suggest a possible narrower phenotype, with implications for personalized treatment if validated and further investigation into the thyroid-depression interface.

title: Plasma neurotransmitter-related metabolite alterations in adolescent major depressive disorder with and without psychotic features.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Whether adolescent major depressive disorder (MDD) with psychotic features has a distinct peripheral metabolite signature remains uncertain. We compared targeted plasma neurotransmitter-related metabolites in psychotic MDD, non-psychotic MDD, and healthy controls.
METHODS: We enrolled 220 adolescents (53 psychotic MDD, 67 non-psychotic MDD, 100 controls) and quantified 14 metabolites spanning tryptophan, glutamate-GABA, and catecholamine pathways using LC-MS/MS. Age- and sex-adjusted ANCOVA tested group effects on metabolites, biologically informed ratios, and pathway composites with false-discovery rate (FDR) control. Nested cross-validated classifiers evaluated out-of-sample group separability. For psychotic vs non-psychotic contrasts, we reported design sensitivity and Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) equivalence testing (smallest effect size of interest |d| < 0.30).
RESULTS: Versus controls, both MDD subgroups showed lower kynurenic acid and kynurenic acid/kynurenine, higher glutamine, higher glutamate/(serotonin+homovanillic acid), and lower serotonin/homovanillic acid (all FDR < 0.05). The tryptophan composite declined from controls to non-psychotic to psychotic MDD, and the GABA composite was lower in psychotic MDD versus controls. No metabolite or ratio survived FDR correction between psychotic and non-psychotic MDD. With n = 53 vs 67, 80% power corresponded to approximately d ≈ 0.52, and TOST did not support equivalence at |d| < 0.30. Classifiers distinguished pooled MDD vs controls (best AUC = 0.917; balanced accuracy = 0.861) but were near chance for psychotic vs non-psychotic MDD (best AUC = 0.592).
CONCLUSIONS: Targeted plasma metabolomics identified a robust case-control signature in adolescent MDD, centered on tryptophan-pathway and excitation/monoamine balance measures. Within this panel, evidence for a distinct psychotic-feature subtype signature was limited, and small subtype differences remain possible.

title: Effective connectivity of implicit emotion processing in adolescent psychiatric inpatients: Dynamic causal modeling across bipolar disorder and other psychopathologies.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pediatric bipolar disorder(BD) is difficult to distinguish from other psychiatric disorders, a challenge which can result in delayed or incorrect interventions. Understanding objective neural markers reflecting a dysfunction in recognizing implicit facial emotional social cues may aid in early diagnosis in BD.
METHODS: We used neuroimaging and a dynamic causal modeling(DCM) framework to identify effective connectivity(EC) measures differentiating a rarified sample of inpatient adolescents with BD from other inpatient psychopathology(OP), and healthy adolescents(HC) during an emotional faces processing task. We hypothesized that EC patterns would differ between groups, reflecting disorder-specific alterations in neural networks involved in emotion processing, and that within inpatient groups, the observed EC patterns would be associated with the severity of clinical mood symptoms. DCM was used to analyze EC in BD(n = 29), OP(n = 39), and HC(n = 21); mean age 15.26 years, 60 females. Participants performed a dynamic emotional faces paradigm with four conditions: anger, fear, sadness, and happiness. Group-level Parametric Empirical Bayes(PEB) analyses examined EC patterns, followed by correlation analyses of relationships between EC and clinical symptom severity.
RESULTS: Analysis revealed divergent and convergent EC patterns across groups and conditions. EC in BD and OP was associated with self-reported clinical symptoms severity of current mania, current depression, positive and negative affect.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings suggest that altered EC patterns between regions supporting social emotion processing and executive control may underlie difficulties in implicit facial emotion processing. These dysfunctional EC patterns may contribute to social impairments in pediatric BD. Understanding these neural connectivity alterations could inform targeted interventions to mitigate the adverse effects of BD on social functioning in youth.

title: Task-aware multiple instance learning for stress detection from facial video data.
summary: Stress is a prevalent condition linked to a wide range of mental and physical health disorders. Timely detection of stress is critical for enabling early interventions and promoting long-term well-being. Traditional detection methods based on physiological signals, can be effective, but intrusive or unsuitable for continuous or large-scale deployment. In this study, we propose a video-based stress detection method using top-k Multiple Instance Learning. Our approach is based on the assumption that subjects exhibit a mix of high-intensity and less stress-indicative behaviour during stressful tasks. We employ a temporal feature network with multi-head attention and introduce a conditioning mechanism to account for differences between active (speaking) and passive (non-speaking) tasks. To make better use of limited datasets and weak labels, we incorporate both top-k and bottom-k instances, assuming that bottom-k snippets reflect neutral or less stress-indicative behaviour even in stress-related videos. We validate our approach on our own stress dataset and the publicly available StressID dataset. In a leave-five-subjects-out evaluation, our method achieves high accuracy and F1 scores, outperforming baseline methods while providing interpretable temporal localisation of stress-related behaviour.

title: A Single, Interpretable Vocal Biomarker for Enriching Antipsychotic Clinical Trials.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Speech latency, an objective measure of verbal response time, is sensitive to cognitive, social, and motivational factors and can be measured using recordings of psychiatric interviews. Emerging evidence suggests that it can be used to enrich participants in antidepressant clinical trials, resulting in nearly double the drug-placebo effect at half the sample size. Here, we evaluated whether enrichment of participants using speech latency ratios, a variant of speech latency accounting for duration of response, improved outcomes in a clinical trial of schizophrenia.
METHODS: Audio recordings from psychiatric interviews in a phase 3, 28-day, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, fixed-dose, multicenter, parallel-group monotherapy study of brilaroxazine (RP5063) were examined. There were 2320 recordings for 406 participants with acute psychosis from 3 countries representing 8 languages.
RESULTS: Speech latency ratios showed excellent internal consistency, good temporal stability, and minimal convergence with potential confounders. Patients with (vs. without) moderate-to-severe negative symptoms showed longer speech latencies, with large effect sizes observed in nearly every country and language. A single speech latency ratio value (area under the curve = 0.71) identified 180 and 228 participants as being vocal biomarker negative (VBM neg; unremarkable speech) and VBM positive (VBM pos; relatively high ratios), respectively. Brilaroxazine showed statistically significant outcomes versus placebo from baseline to end of treatment in the VBM-pos group for nearly every outcome measure despite having fewer participants. Treatment effects for VBM-pos patients were large for nearly every outcome measure.
CONCLUSIONS: Speech latency ratios are a face-valid, objective biomarker derived from standard clinical assessments. As an enrichment tool, it reduced sample size needs and enhanced outcomes. This has important implications for reducing clinical trial costs and burden.

标题：一种单一、可解释的语音生物标志物用于丰富抗精神病药物临床试验  
摘要：背景：言语延迟（一种客观的言语反应时间测量指标）对认知、社会和动机因素敏感，可通过精神病访谈录音进行测量。新证据表明，该指标可用于富集抗抑郁药物临床试验的参与者，从而在样本量减半的情况下使药物-安慰剂效应几乎翻倍。本研究评估了使用言语延迟比率（一种考虑反应持续时间的言语延迟变体）富集参与者是否能改善精神分裂症临床试验的结果。  
方法：本研究分析了一项针对brilaroxazine（RP5063）的3期、28天、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、固定剂量、多中心、平行组单药治疗研究中精神病访谈的录音。共采集来自3个国家（涵盖8种语言）406名急性精神病患者的2320条录音。  
结果：言语延迟比率显示出优异的内部一致性、良好的时间稳定性，且与潜在混杂因素的收敛性极低。与无中重度阴性症状的患者相比，有中重度阴性症状的患者表现出更长的言语延迟，且几乎在每一个国家和语言中均观察到较大的效应量。单个言语延迟比率值（曲线下面积=0.71）分别识别出180名和228名参与者为语音生物标志物阴性（VBM neg；言语无异常）和阳性（VBM pos；比率相对较高）。在VBM阳性组中，从基线到治疗结束，brilaroxazine在几乎所有结局指标上均显示出显著优于安慰剂的统计学结果，尽管该组参与者人数较少。VBM阳性患者的治疗效应在几乎所有结局指标上均较大。  
结论：言语延迟比率是一种源自标准临床评估的表观效度客观生物标志物。作为富集工具，它减少了样本量需求并增强了治疗效果。这对降低临床试验成本和负担具有重要意义。

title: Multivariate Resting-State Functional Connectivity Features Linked to Transdiagnostic Psychopathology in Early Psychosis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Early psychosis (EP) is characterized by neurobiological changes, including alterations in resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC). We now understand that symptoms and neural changes may overlap across EP diagnostic categories. However, the relationship between RSFC patterns and transdiagnostic symptom dimensions remains poorly understood.
METHODS: We used partial least squares correlation to examine multivariate relationships between whole-brain RSFC and clinical symptoms in 124 patients with EP (ages 16-35 years) diagnosed with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, or a psychotic mood disorder. RSFC was computed among 216 cortical and subcortical regions. Clinical assessment included 41 symptom measures spanning positive, negative, general psychopathology, and manic dimensions.
RESULTS: Analysis revealed one significant latent component (p < .001) capturing 41.6% of the RSFC symptom covariance. This component was characterized by increased between-network connectivity, particularly involving sensory-motor, default mode, and subcortical regions including the amygdala and thalamus. The associated symptom profile included cognitive rigidity and arousal dysregulation (stereotyped thinking, anxiety, and somatic concerns) rather than traditional positive or negative symptoms. This brain-behavior relationship was consistent across diagnoses and independent of medication and substance use. The clinical relevance of this relationship was validated through significant correlations with standardized measures of hostility (r = 0.23), negative affect (r = 0.25), and perceived stress (r = 0.22).
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings reveal a distinct transdiagnostic phenotype in EP characterized by cognitive inflexibility and arousal dysregulation that is associated with altered integration between sensory, default mode, and subcortical networks. This work suggests that specific patterns of network-level FC may relate to symptom dimensions that cut across conventional diagnostic boundaries, potentially informing more targeted therapeutic approaches.

标题：早期精神病跨诊断精神病理学相关的多变量静息态功能连接特征
摘要：背景：早期精神病以神经生物学变化为特征，包括静息态功能连接的改变。目前已知症状和神经变化可能在早期精神病的不同诊断类别间重叠。然而，静息态功能连接模式与跨诊断症状维度之间的关系仍知之甚少。方法：我们使用偏最小二乘相关分析，研究了124名早期精神病患者（年龄16-35岁，诊断为精神分裂症、分裂情感障碍或精神病性心境障碍）的全脑静息态功能连接与临床症状之间的多变量关系。静息态功能连接在216个皮质和皮质下区域之间计算。临床评估包括涵盖阳性、阴性、一般精神病理学和躁狂维度的41项症状测量。结果：分析揭示了一个显著的潜在成分（p < .001），捕获了静息态功能连接-症状协方差的41.6%。该成分的特征是网络间连接增强，特别是涉及感觉运动网络、默认模式网络以及包括杏仁核和丘脑在内的皮质下区域。相关的症状特征包括认知僵化和唤醒失调（刻板思维、焦虑和躯体关注），而非传统的阳性或阴性症状。这种脑-行为关系在各诊断类别间一致，且不受药物和物质使用的影响。该关系的临床相关性通过与敌意（r = 0.23）、负性情感（r = 0.25）和感知压力（r = 0.22）的标准化测量的显著相关得到验证。结论：我们的研究发现早期精神病中一种独特的跨诊断表型，其特征是认知僵化和唤醒失调，与感觉、默认模式和皮质下网络之间的整合改变相关。这项工作表明，特定模式的网络水平功能连接可能与跨越传统诊断界限的症状维度相关，可能为更有针对性的治疗方法提供信息。
关键词：早期精神病；静息态功能连接；跨诊断症状；情感；脑网络
